Chapter 1286: 34: Eternal Envoy

Chapter 1286: Chapter 34: Eternal Envoy

The Magic Origin Fruit tree considered it ‘inferior’.

It was not about size, magnitude, or heritage.

If such aspects were the comparison, then the Chaos Void is undeniably the largest and most indisputable existence among the surrounding dimensional gaps.

Even among dimensional spaces, there are distinctions of height, and the Chaos Void is undoubtedly the pinnacle of dimensional spaces.

Lin Yuan’s internal universe, in this regard, is still far from matching the Chaos Void.

But aside from these, purely in terms of the perfection level of the spatial world.

The Magic Origin Fruit tree actually believed the Chaos Void was inferior to this internal universe.

In terms of every detail of the rules and the operation of the great Dao, this internal universe is more complete.

“How is this possible?”

The Magic Origin Fruit tree found it hard to believe.

What kind of existence is the Chaos Void? It’s already a colossal entity, plus each Time Being’s supplementary perfection.

It has already reached some extreme, how could it be surpassed?

“This lord… what is this lord’s origin?”

The Magic Origin Fruit tree trembled inwardly, as the saying goes, “blue is extracted from the indigo plant but surpasses it in blue”, it generally doesn’t appear in the world-nurturing domain.

The world spaces that are nurtured by the Chaos Void already have their foundations set, essentially possessing no possibility of surpassing the Chaos Void.

Yet Lin Yuan’s internal universe broke this point, causing the Magic Origin Fruit tree to have a deeper impact.

For example, Lin Yuan’s terrifying background, being a Time Being from another dimensional space, sneaking into the Chaos Void with some plan?

To be able to silently integrate into a dimensional space like the Chaos Void, a Time Being must be at least at the level of a Lord, which requires a great cost.

“Time Lord?”

The Magic Origin Fruit tree’s heart trembled.

Even in the mysterious dimensional gaps, the actions at the Time Lord level are extremely rare, at least the Magic Origin Fruit tree had once watched the skirmishes of Time Beings from afar.

But Time Lord?

The Magic Origin Fruit tree had never even seen one.

At the level of the Time Lord, they plot their own timeline, past, present, future as one, sealing their timeline, isolating everything, trying to impact the perfect realm.

Such an existence might even have some abilities of a Perfect Time Being, able to travel to the past, altering the past in a limited way.

Of course, not reaching the fourteenth rank, even a Time Lord needs to pay a heavy price to change the past.

Actually, by the thirteenth rank, the struggles between Time Beings no longer involve spatial ranges but rather gradually revolve around timelines.

Plotting battles in the past, laying out strategies for future battles.

This is the nature of Time Beings.

Some Time Beings abandon the gains and losses of the present to plan for a successful future.

The victories and defeats between Time Beings are not confined to the present but must stretch the timeline to view from a distant future.

“No wonder, no wonder.”

The Magic Origin Fruit tree suddenly realized.

If Lin Yuan is a great Time Lord, then everything makes sense. Having such terrifying power, it being on a Time Lord seems much more reasonable.

“But a great Time Lord, paying a huge price to sneak into this dimensional space, what could be the plan?”

The Magic Origin Fruit tree couldn’t help but think.

What could a Time Lord, at such a height, be willing to infiltrate for?

“Forget it.”

“These are not things I can contemplate.”

The Magic Origin Fruit tree shook its head. With the distant future seen by a Time Lord, there must be a profound meaning in doing so. As not even a Time Being, I cannot understand the Time Lord’s scheme.

“This time for me, it might be a great opportunity.”

The Magic Origin Fruit tree suddenly thought, being abducted by a Time Lord is not a bad thing, at least considered the ‘tree’ of a Time Lord?

…

The second Fang Yuan World, Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

The true self of Lin Yuan had long returned from the trial space opened by the Master of Wushan.

However, a manifestation was left there to continuously comprehend the inheritance left by the Lord of Heaven Light.

“Rune Dao…”

Sitting cross-legged, Lin Yuan concentrated his mind on understanding the Lord of Heaven Light’s interpretation of the runes.

“Using Spiritual Power, Qi and Blood Power, Soul Power, and other forces to condense runes, is the simplest application of runes and is also the most superficial understanding.”

The gentle light of the Lord of Heaven Light illuminated everywhere, with Lin Yuan earnestly comprehending.

The original inheritance left by the Master of Wushan contained the imprint of the Lord of Heaven Light within, utilizing this imprint is equivalent to directly ‘facing’ the Lord of Heaven Light, which greatly aids in understanding this heritage.

This is also the reason why the original inheritance is precious.

Even the most precious replicated inheritance would slightly deviate from the creator’s original intent.

“The inheritance I created divides into five levels. The first level, the carrier of the rune is no longer one’s own power, but the heaven and earth, mountains and stones can all form runes.”

“The second level, all tangible bodies, including all beings, can become the carrier of the rune, coagulating a rune.”

“The third level, intangible things like the seven emotions and six desires can also coagulate a rune. At this level, even if trapped in a time loop, without the direct use of Rune Dao, it can also be used indirectly.”

The Lord of Heaven Light spoke with a gentle tone, like a kindly teaching teacher.

“The heaven and earth is a rune, tangible bodies are runes, the seven emotions and six desires are also runes?”

In Lin Yuan’s mind, many inspirations surged.

Understanding of the runes is rapidly improving.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to comprehend the rune inheritance, greatly enhancing your perception of the Rune Dao…]

With Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, it took only more than half a month to fully comprehend the third level.

“Seven Emotions and Six Desires?”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred, and his anger was stripped away, forming a small rune.

“No wonder the Lord of Heaven Light is confident that comprehending the third level can help break through the time loop.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly. Although he didn’t know which kind of time loop he was trapped in, as long as there is life, there will inevitably be seven emotions and six desires, which can thus become carriers for the runes.

The power of blood and energy, soul power, spiritual power, and the power of the world universe may all be sealed and unusable, but the seven emotions and six desires? Without them, is it still life?

It’s impossible that the time loop he is trapped in has no life whatsoever? Even if there are no other life forms, he himself is a life form and can produce the seven emotions and six desires as carriers for the runes.

Of course, within the time loop, even if you find a rune carrier, the power it ultimately exerts will significantly diminish, but at least it’s no longer without any support.

“The fourth level.”

Lin Yuan looked towards the inheritance of the fourth level.

He could understand the first three levels in a short period of time because of his Against-Heaven’s Understanding and the Eternal Painting of the Master of Wushan.

The latter gave him a general understanding of the Rune Dao of this Fang Yuan World, and then he comprehended the inheritance left by the Lord of Heaven Light. With the enhancement of Against-Heaven’s Understanding, his progress was naturally rapid.

“What are runes? They are everything, all that you see and feel can also become carriers of runes.” The Lord of Heaven Light smiled, explaining to Lin Yuan carefully.

“All that you see and feel?”

Lin Yuan nodded; this encompassed a vast range, especially in a time loop. Perhaps in the time loop he is trapped in, life is scarce, with only him. In such a case, even if he can produce the seven emotions and six desires, it is still very limited.

And all that you see and feel?

Anything seen and felt can become a carrier for the runes.

“The Lord of Heaven Light…”

Lin Yuan once again felt the terrifying power of this Eternal Lord, while the Master of Wushan’s pursuit was to paint a picture of the Source World.

Whereas the Lord of Heaven Light pursued everything.

“Could such a powerful time being also be trapped? Or is it that they willingly allow themselves to be trapped?”

Lin Yuan’s heart felt heavy. According to the test space “Spirit” created by the Master of Wushan, all Eternal Lords, including him, were trapped.

Only in this way could there be a faint chance of turning things around in the future.

If they were not trapped, perhaps the Eternal Lords could survive, but the Fang Yuan World was destined for destruction, with no chance of reversal.

It is precisely because of this that the Master of Wushan and other Eternal Lords actively chose to be trapped, their powers sealed, unable to interfere with the world after the descent of the ‘Demon’ disaster.

“Continue comprehending.”

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts and began to comprehend the fourth level of the inheritance.

Compared to the first three levels, the comprehension of the fourth level took Lin Yuan a little longer.

However, with Lin Yuan’s understanding, it was only a matter of time.

In fact, many strong individuals have cultivated and comprehended the inheritance created by the Lord of Heaven Light.

But most only stopped at the first level? The second level?

As for the third level? Since the spread of this inheritance, very few strong individuals have comprehended the third level.

No one has comprehended the fourth level.

Not everyone has the accumulation and understanding like Lin Yuan.

In the eyes of those powerful individuals in the realm of freedom, this inheritance is like a heavenly book. Even though they know comprehension is greatly beneficial to becoming an Eternal Lord, they still need to be able to comprehend it.

Even strong as the Eternal Lords, a large part of them have not comprehended the fourth level.

…

The main hall at the highest point of Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

The Sect Master of the Holy Sect and the elders have been very pleased lately.

Due to Lin Yuan’s presence, the ‘Demons’ around Qingyun Sacred Mountain have nearly disappeared.

The Sect Master and the elders had many speculations about this at first, but after confirming it was Lin Yuan’s doing.

They suddenly relaxed.

With Lin Yuan, the Qingyun Saint Sect is as stable as Mount Tai, with no need to worry about being broken by those great demons.

How could the Sect Master and elders not feel delighted?

The demon disaster is widespread, and even though the Holy Sect and the Supreme Saint Sect have perpetuated their legacy, they face overwhelming pressure all the time.

The central Eternal Sect of the world is no exception.

The Eternal Sect’s foundation is unfathomable, with methods arranged in advance by the Eternal Lord, but it faces even greater pressure.

One Source Demon after another, even a Demon God?

“Hmm?”

Just then, the Sect Master’s expression slightly changed, and on the distant high platform of the hall, a cyan rune slowly lit up.

“This rune can sense the message from the central Eternal Sect, is there an Eternal Envoy arriving soon?” The Sect Master’s mind was shaken.

It’s been unknown how long since the last Eternal Envoy arrived.

So long that the Sect Master thought there might be a great problem with the central Eternal Sect.

…

Deep in the Qingyun Institute.

Upon learning that the Eternal Envoy was about to arrive, the Sect Master immediately informed Lin Yuan.

“Eternal Envoy? The strong individuals dispatched by the Eternal Sect are coming?” Lin Yuan looked at the Sect Master.
